QUOTE: "**Facts (tier 3) and ecosystem signatures (tier 4) are never displaced.** They accumulate beneath any stated value. So passing `--entry-patterns` does not drop `main`. The stated tier can only correct guesses; it cannot un-discover a fact."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the stated tiers replace one another ("replaces the declaration's values, not adds"; the formula `tier1 or tier2 or tier5`). Discovered tiers 3 and 4 accumulate and are never displaced.
